Representing Brazil for the [[QuakeCon 2016]] 2on2 tournament was thought to be {{Flag/br}} [[mur]] and {{Flag/br}} [[GT]]. But for reasons not fully revealed, mur was unsuccessful in getting the visa in approved, or atleast so the rumours has it. In his place, {{Flag/br}} [[dev]] jumped in to fill his shoes.

In 2017, finally, the team showed up at [[QHLAN2017]] in full force claiming 3rd place finish.
